Native-safe replacements summary: (1) react-i18next useTranslation('settings') -> useSettingsTranslation fallback (every key + English fallback preserved verbatim; {{var}} interpolation for previewHeader/summary/errorJson/appliedDetail). (2) useToast -> Alert.alert(title,message). (3) The browser file intake (`<input type='file'>` change, HTML5 onDrop/onDragOver/onDragLeave DragEvent handlers, File.text()) is UNAVAILABLE on native and no document-picker module is bundled; the full ingest->validate->dry-run->preview->apply pipeline is preserved intact in ingestFile and reached through an injectable importFileSource prop (a native picker adapter / tests supply it), with an explicit settings-import-unavailable notice + Alert when none is wired, and the dragActive highlight mapped onto press-in/press-out. (4) downloadSettingsBundle (Blob/URL.createObjectURL/anchor) is browser-only -> the native hook throws SettingsBundleDownloadUnavailableError; the export still fetches the bundle and surfaces a settings-export-ready notice via createSettingsBundleExportPayload + nativeSettingsBackupCapabilities.unavailableReason. (5) FadeIn/Spinner/Heading/Text/HelperText/ErrorText/Code/IconBox/Button -> RN primitives + AppText + theme tokens; lucide SVGs -> unicode glyphs.

Verified NO DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements (div/section/h2/p/span/ul/li/input/button), `<input type=file>`, DragEvent/ChangeEvent, Blob/URL.createObjectURL/document anchor, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, clsx, react-i18next, framer-motion, or old web ui/feedback/motion components are imported -- only react-native primitives (ActivityIndicator/Alert/Platform/Pressable/StyleSheet/View) plus the existing shared native AppText, GlassPanel, theme tokens (colors/spacing), the native api/client (isApiError/SudoCanceledError) and the native useSettingsBackup hooks/types. All state names (pending/stage/parseError/previewResult/appliedResult/dragActive/fileInputId), the validateSettingsBundle/summariseImportResult/SETTINGS_BUNDLE_SECTION_KEYS/MAX_IMPORT_FILE_BYTES logic, the API paths (/settings/export, /settings/import dry_run true/false), the SudoCanceledError handling, every i18n key + English fallback, and every data-testid (settings-export-import/-export-button/-import-dropzone/-import-error/-import-preview/-import-apply/-import-applied/-import-section-list) are preserved. Gates run from apps/native: `npm run typecheck` (clean, exit 0), `npm run lint -- --quiet` (clean, exit 0), `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` (50 suites / 296 tests pass, incl. the new __tests__/SettingsExportImportParity.test.tsx: idle render with explicit unavailable note, export save-as-unavailable notice, pending-export spinner, injected-source validate->dry-run->preview->apply, invalid-JSON inline error, schema-version local reject before dry-run, SudoCanceled keeps preview, and the no-source unavailable Alert).
